job.title: Junior Insurance Broker
job.description:
Take the next step in your insurance career

Our client is a specialist insurance brokerage with a strong reputation in the Financial Lines space. They are looking to add a Junior Broker to their growing Sydney team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an insurance professional from either a claims or underwriting background or even someone from financial services looking to transition career.
The Opportunity Working alongside experienced brokers and industry specialists, you’ll gain exposure to a broad range of Financial Lines and General Lines products and develop your technical, broking and client management skills.

You’ll be involved in:
  • Supporting brokers with the management of a portfolio of Financial Lines clients
  • Assisting with new business and renewal processes
  • Preparing submissions, quotes and policy documentation
  • Liaising with insurers and underwriters to negotiate appropriate coverage
  • Assisting with client enquiries and day-to-day account management
  • Reviewing policy wordings and identifying key coverage considerations
  • Developing strong relationships with clients, insurers and other stakeholders
  • Building your technical knowledge across the Financial Lines market
About You
We’re particularly interested in hearing from candidates with 1–3 years’ experience in general insurance, including those currently working in:
  • Claims, particularly within Financial Lines, Professional Indemnity, D&O or related areas
  • Underwriting, ideally within Financial Lines or a related class
  • Junior broking or broking support
We’re looking for:
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • A good understanding of insurance principles
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach
  • The ability to build strong relationships
  • A genuine interest in Financial Lines and insurance broking
  • A willingness to learn and develop technically
Why Join? 
You’ll benefit from:
  • Specialist exposure to Financial Lines
  • Strong technical and professional development
  • Support and mentoring from experienced brokers
  • A collaborative and high-performing team
  • Clear career progression
  • The opportunity to build a long-term career in broking
  • Sydney-based role with a strong company culture
If you’re currently working in claims or underwriting and have been considering a move into broking, this could be an ideal opportunity to make the transition.
Apply now for a confidential discussion.
